title: Chevening Scholarship 2027/28
window: Closes 6 October 2026, 11:00 UTC
summary: One-year fully funded master's at any UK university, in any subject (public health, health policy, global health and similar fit well). Needs two years of work experience and a return to Nigeria for two years after.

title: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
window: Annual call, usually opens in autumn. Check the CSC page for the current deadline.
summary: Full-time taught master's in the UK for candidates from eligible Commonwealth countries. Covers tuition, living allowance and airfare. Public health and global health courses are common choices.

title: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships
window: Annual call. Check the CSC page for eligibility by country and the current deadline.
summary: Fully funded PhD study in the UK for candidates from eligible Commonwealth countries, including development-focused health research.

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program (graduate)
destination: Canada, Africa and other partner countries
window: Each partner university runs its own cycle. New calls are picked up automatically from the feeds below.
summary: Full funding for African graduates at partner universities such as Toronto, McGill, Cape Town, Makerere and Ashesi. Health programmes include MPH, health informatics and health administration.

title: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS)
window: Deadlines vary by course, mostly between August and October for the following year.
summary: Monthly stipend, tuition, health insurance and travel for master's courses relevant to development, including international health and public health programmes.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
window: Nigeria applications are usually handled through the US Embassy Abuja. Check the Fulbright page for this year's dates.
summary: Graduate study in the US including master's and doctoral work in public health and related fields.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
window: International students apply in two rounds, usually October and early December.
summary: Full-cost scholarships at the University of Cambridge for PhD and selected master's programmes, with a leadership and social-impact focus.

title: Clarendon Scholarships
window: Decided automatically from your graduate application, so apply by the January course deadline.
summary: Fully funded graduate scholarships at Oxford, awarded across all subjects including population health and medical sciences.

title: Rotary Peace Fellowships
window: Applications usually close in mid-May each year.
summary: Fully funded master's degree or professional certificate in peace and conflict studies. Suits doctors working in humanitarian and community health.

title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program
window: Application window changes yearly. Check the World Bank scholarships page.
summary: Master's study in development-related fields at approved universities, including public health, for professionals from developing countries.

title: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
window: Usually opens around October and closes in the following months.
summary: Full master's funding in Sweden for professionals with leadership potential. Open to Nigerian citizens.

title: Australia Awards Africa
window: Usually opens in the first half of the year. Check the official page.
summary: Fully funded master's study in Australia for African professionals, with priority sectors that often include health.

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's (EMJM)
window: Each consortium sets its own deadline, mostly December to February.
summary: Joint master's programmes taught in two or more European countries, with scholarships covering tuition, travel and living costs. Several programmes are in public health, infectious disease and biomedicine.

title: Turkiye Burslari Scholarships
window: Applications normally run from January to late February.
summary: Tuition, housing, monthly stipend, health insurance and flights for master's and doctoral study.

title: Chinese Government Scholarship
window: Windows differ by route (bilateral or university track). Usually between January and April.
summary: Full scholarships for graduate study at Chinese universities, including clinical medicine and public health.

title: Mandela Rhodes Scholarship
window: Annual call, typically mid-year. Check the foundation page.
summary: Postgraduate funding for young Africans at South African universities, with a leadership development programme.

title: Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine scholarships for Nigerians
window: The most recent round closed on 15 April 2026. Check the page for the next intake.
summary: Funding for Nigerian applicants to master's courses in tropical medicine, public health and global health at LSTM.

title: EDCTP Global Health Fellowships
window: Calls are announced on the EDCTP website. Check for the current call.
summary: Career development fellowships for clinical researchers working on poverty-related infectious diseases in sub-Saharan Africa.

title: Fleming Fund Fellowship Scheme
window: Cohort calls are announced on the Fleming Fund site. Check for open rounds.
summary: Fellowships on antimicrobial resistance for health and laboratory professionals in low- and middle-income countries.

title: TDR Postgraduate Training Scheme
window: Calls are posted on the TDR site. Check for open rounds.
summary: Postgraduate training in implementation research for health professionals from low- and middle-income countries.

title: NLNG Postgraduate Scholarship
window: Announced once a year. Watch the NLNG site and national newspapers.
summary: Fully funded UK master's for Nigerian graduates, covering tuition, accommodation, living costs, flights and insurance.

title: TETFund postgraduate scholarships
window: Awarded through beneficiary institutions. Relevant if you join a Nigerian university as academic staff.
summary: Staff development awards for lecturers in public tertiary institutions, including medical specialisation in Nigerian universities.

title: Nigeria Field Epidemiology and Laboratory Training Programme (NFELTP)
provider: NFELTP, with the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control
window: Cohorts are announced periodically. Watch the programme site.
summary: In-service training in outbreak investigation and applied epidemiology. Fellows produce field reports and publishable work, which is strong portfolio material for a doctor.

title: Nigerian Institute of Medical Research, Lagos
window: No fixed call. Contact the research departments about attachments.
summary: Federal research institute working on malaria, HIV, tuberculosis and other diseases. A route to a research attachment or a junior research role.

title: Institute of Human Virology Nigeria (IHVN)
window: Openings are posted on the careers page. Check regularly.
summary: Large HIV and public health research and programme organisation. Offers clinical research and programme roles where a young doctor can get published.

title: African Centre of Excellence for Genomics of Infectious Diseases (ACEGID)
window: Training and research openings are announced on the site.
summary: Genomics and infectious disease research centre known for Lassa fever work. Offers postgraduate training and research collaboration.

title: MRC Unit The Gambia at LSHTM: research training
window: Training, internship and fellowship calls are posted on the site.
summary: One of Africa's largest clinical research units. Runs training, studentships and fellowships for African health graduates.

title: Epicentre, the MSF epidemiology and research centre
window: Check the site for current openings and training.
summary: Field epidemiology and clinical research in outbreaks and humanitarian settings, run by Medecins Sans Frontieres.

title: Global Health Corps Fellowship
window: Annual call. Check the site for the current cycle.
summary: A year-long fellowship placing emerging leaders in health organisations. Builds programme, data and policy experience alongside clinical training.

title: Publish a case report in BMJ Case Reports
window: Rolling submissions. Check fees and waivers before you submit.
summary: A peer-reviewed home for case reports. Writing and publishing one from your own clinical encounters is the fastest first publication for a new doctor. Needs patient consent.

title: Cochrane: get involved as a volunteer
window: Rolling. Choose a task that fits your time.
summary: Help screen trial reports, translate summaries or join a review group. The best free way to learn systematic review methods and evidence synthesis.

title: UN Online Volunteering
window: Rolling. Browse current assignments and filter for health and research.
summary: Volunteer from home on research, writing, data and translation tasks for UN agencies and NGOs. Gives you verifiable international experience.

title: WikiProject Medicine: edit health articles
window: Open any time.
summary: Improve the world's most-read health pages using high-quality sources. Teaches critical appraisal and plain-language science writing.

title: WHO internship programme
window: Rolling vacancies. Read the eligibility rules on enrolment and graduation date first.
summary: Internships at WHO headquarters, regional and country offices, including Nigeria. Strong signal on a research or public health CV.

title: Free Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training and certificate
window: Self-paced, available any time.
summary: Free online GCP course with a certificate. Most trial sites and research groups ask for it before they will take you on.

title: The Global Health Network training centre
window: Self-paced, available any time.
summary: Free courses on research methods, ethics, trial design and data management, built for researchers in low- and middle-income countries.

title: OpenWHO free courses
window: Self-paced, available any time.
summary: Free courses on outbreaks, epidemiology, infection prevention and health emergencies, with certificates of completion.

title: Cochrane Interactive Learning
window: Self-paced, available any time.
summary: Free modules that walk you through conducting a systematic review. A good base before you join a review team.

title: EQUATOR Network reporting guidelines
window: Free resource, available any time.
summary: The checklists journals expect for case reports, trials, cohort studies and reviews. Use them to write papers that get accepted.

title: Wellcome Connecting Science courses and conferences
window: Scheduled events with scholarships. Check each course page for dates.
summary: Short courses and conferences in genomics, bioinformatics and global health, many with scholarships for researchers from Africa.
